benchmarks.method: Five alternating fresh-case pairs after discarded warmup pair; startup, diagnostics and output included; generation/meshing excluded; no simultaneous agent CPU compilation or GPU experiments during measured pairs.

omp_sweep.note: Thermal 512 cells/region; two measured alternating repetitions after warmup, before final removal of the unused microBase copy. Exact physical payload and CSV parity for all 1/4/8/32-thread runs. Scheduling evidence, not a scaling claim.

profiler_note: API call counts and GPU transfer bytes from separate Nsight traces; profiler wall times are excluded from benchmark medians.
